name: MIDI file export

dependencies.reason: Result/Status and the Ticks type (960 per quarter, matching the pattern grid)

threading: Pure functions; thread-safe. Not real-time safe (allocates).
standalone_test_command: cmake -S modules/midi_export -B build/midi_export && cmake --build build/midi_export && ctest --test-dir build/midi_export
summary: Deterministic Standard MIDI File (format 0) encoder and decoder for note sequences with tempo and time-signature events. The tick grid equals the pattern engine's, so exported hits land on exact ticks.
public_api: `FileSpec{bpm, timeSignature, trackName, notes[]}`, `Note{note, velocity, start, duration, channel}`
limits: 960 ticks per quarter; notes 0..127, velocity 1..127, at most 65536 notes; same-pitch overlaps are clipped and zero-length results dropped
adapters: Your app maps its own events to `Note` values and writes the bytes to disk.
adapter_notes: Pitch is just a number; map chops to notes however your sampler expects.
removal: Delete the folder; callers lose MIDI export only.
